Long nutrition post about sugar cravings; no brand of any kind, dairy or otherwise.

The caption lists every product line but drops every single TM printed on the pages -- «Торчин», «День у День», «SOT», «Своя Лінія» -- and closes with 'різних брендів'; the watchlist brand svoia-liniia is legible on the jar labels of p.4441 and exists nowhere but in the images.
Storm warning card, transcribed almost verbatim; the only proper name in the image is «ПИРЯТИНСЬКА ГРОМАДА», the municipality logo, which is not a brand mention.

«Премія»® carries the registered-mark glyph and sits on cod liver, not dairy -- a watchlist private label attached to a non-tracked category, so a hit for the brand question and empty for the dairy one.
Protest report; «сиром» (cheese) appears as a bare food word with no TM -- category vocabulary without any brand behind it.

Three referents of one token in one post: ТМ «Селянське» milk, ТМ «Селянське» butter, and «Морозиво ТМ «Рудь» «Селянське» пломбір», where Селянське is a Rud ice-cream line and not the dairy TM -- a matcher keyed on the token cannot tell the third from the first two.
Municipal water-supply notice from a Myrhorod channel; the toponym never becomes «Миргородська корівка», and nothing else in the text is a brand.

«Масло солодковершкове 73% ТМ Вершкове» -- the TM is a substring of the product descriptor «солодковершкове» in the same line, so any substring matcher fires twice on one mention; the channel handle carries VARUS but the post text does not.
Six pages of non-food promo (toys, stationery, clothing, kitchenware, household) -- the caption's category list matches every page and there is no food, let alone dairy, anywhere in the leaflet.

Job ad, fully and correctly transcribed including the «Хвилинка» name; the caption calls it 'фотографія піци' and does not mention that the upper half is a «УНІВЕРСАМ ХВИЛИНКА» storefront -- a retail-context omission, not a category one.
Parenting poll about guilt over alone time; no products and no brands in either the question or the six options.
Three-line holiday joke post; nothing to extract.
Baked-camembert recipe: «Сир камамбер» is a cheese type, not a TM -- a recipe post is dense in dairy vocabulary and empty of dairy brands.

«Крем-сир (Філадельфія)» -- a real dairy brand name used generically as a cream-cheese style in a recipe ingredient list; present as a name, but it is a mention of the product type rather than of the manufacturer's offering.
Recipe with «Крем-сир — 150 г» given as a bare ingredient with no TM at all.
War-news item about strike depth; no consumer products of any kind.
Child-dehydration advice; «грудне молоко» and «суміш» are generic terms, no formula or dairy TM is named.
«Морозиво, масло, ... » is a bare category teaser for a Маркетопт promo whose products live behind an app link -- the tracked categories are named and every brand sits outside the post.

A whole dairy page (p.36) with five watchlist TMs is compressed into 'молочні продукти'; «РЯЖАНКА ТМ Селянська» is the feminine form agreeing with ряжанка, which the canon's «Селянське» would miss, while the same page's «МАСЛО 73% Селянське ТМ Столиця смаку» uses Селянське as the butter grade and not as the TM -- one token, one true miss and one false positive on the same page.
